title: Vijay Pratap Nishad v. State of U.P.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Amreshwar Pratap Sahi, J.; Rajiv Lochan Mehrotra, J.
disposition: Writ not entertained; relegated to compounding or EE dispute.
headnote: Writ challenging realisation of an electricity bill arising from a Section 135 theft case not entertained. Remedies are compounding under Section 152 of the Electricity Act, 2003 or, if the assessment is disputed, a dispute before the Executive Engineer under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. Petition consigned to records.
facts: Vijay Pratap Nishad approached the Allahabad High Court by a writ petition against the State of U.P. and the electricity department, contending that he had been unnecessarily burdened with realization of an electricity bill which did not concern him. The record showed that a case of electricity theft had been registered against him under Section 135 of the Electricity Act, 2003. Counsel for the petitioner and for the Electricity Department were heard.

holding_units.topic: compounding and Supply Code dispute as remedies for s.135 theft bill
holding_units.holding: A writ petition challenging realisation of an electricity bill arising from a theft case registered under Section 135 of the Electricity Act, 2003 will not be entertained. The petitioner's remedies are compounding under Section 152 of the 2003 Act or, if disputing any assessment arising therefrom, a dispute before the Executive Engineer under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.

not_decided.point: whether the electricity bill concerned the petitioner, and the correctness of the Section 135 theft assessment
not_decided.note: Writ not entertained on the merits; left to compounding under s.152 or the Executive Engineer under the Supply Code.
